label: t24 = t22 regenerated with another generator seed (20260927 instead of 20260912): same effects files, recipe, trial and packaging; a replicate that measures how much the official score moves between two random draws of the same prediction
claim_type: prediction registered before generation and submission; not a measurement
one_factor: against t22 only the generator seed changes (stage 45 --seed 20260927); nothing about the model changes
why: Every rule registered since t17 reads a difference against +/-0.005, and every reading so far has noted that the difference carries generator noise of unknown size: t17 - t15 = +0.0012, t20 - t16 = +0.0020 and t22 - t20 = +0.0016, all inside the band. Stage 45 draws every cell from one random stream (Poisson counts at library sizes resampled from each context's controls), so a second seed of the same effects measures on the official scorer, member by member, how large a difference the generator alone makes.

expected.pds_raw: t22 +/- 0.002 (400 cells per target average out most counting noise)
expected.note: priors, not measurements: the DE members should move more than pds_cosine because they depend on which genes cross the Wilcoxon threshold

reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.measure: D = |t24 - t22|, one draw of the difference two seeds make. A difference between two single-seed submissions has the same noise, and one draw of a half-normal has median 0.674 of its scale, so a 2-SD threshold is about 3 x D. One pair gives a crude estimate, and it is read as one
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.D <= 0.0017: the +/-0.005 threshold of the registered rules is about 2 SD of generator noise or more: kept for the next rules
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.D > 0.0017: the next rules use +/-max(0.005, 3 x D), rounded up to the next 0.001, or ask for a seed replicate of the candidate; rules already registered (t23) keep their thresholds, and their readings add whether the difference exceeds 3 x D
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.per member: the member differences are recorded as the noise of each member, for the benches' calibration
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.reference_for_attribution: t24 is not a new recipe: the t22 recipe's reference score becomes the mean of t22 and t24, and t24 enters the table of official scores as a replicate of t22
